segments.motivation: To efficiently plan, execute, and monitor projects and ensure timely delivery.
To coordinate team efforts, distribute workload, and track individual and team progress.
To organize personal tasks, understand priorities, and collaborate effectively with teammates.

tasks.purpose: to delegate work and clarify responsibilities
to monitor status and identify roadblocks
to structure team activities and manage dependencies

tasks.context: for project milestones and individual tasks
tasks.purpose: to ensure timely completion and accountability
to facilitate collaboration and keep discussions contextual

benefits.claim: Improves team collaboration and communication on shared projects.
Provides clear visibility into project status and individual task assignments.
Helps organize complex projects and break them down into manageable tasks.

frictions.claim: Can be overwhelming for new users or teams with simple needs due to its extensive features.
Requires consistent team adoption and training to maximize its benefits.
Initial setup and customization for specific workflows can be time-consuming.
